name: EX-04 Urban Defence — Co-located, Working Hours
description: 2-day urban defence planning and execution exercise, working hours (0800–1700) at a shared physical training facility. Day 1 focuses on planning and map exercises; Day 2 on execution and consolidation. Demonstrates working-hours-only scheduling with overnight recess and physical meeting locations throughout.

locks.reason: Day 1 lunch break — no exercise activity
Overnight recess — exercise resumes Day 2 at 0800
Day 2 lunch break — no exercise activity

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins. All participants assemble at Main Hall. Synthetic time activated at Day 1, 0800.

items.title: Physical: Opening Brief — Main Hall
items.description: All participants in Main Hall. Exercise director delivers mission brief, exercise objectives, and ground rules. Physical location: Main Hall, Building 1.

items.title: Ground Assessment — Zone Alpha
items.description: Teams conduct detailed assessment of Zone Alpha (northern urban area). Terrain analysis, key buildings, approach routes, chokepoints.

items.title: Ground Assessment — Zone Bravo
items.description: Parallel assessment of Zone Bravo (southern urban area). Assessment teams report findings to command cell.

items.title: Map Exercise — Urban Terrain Analysis
items.description: Structured map exercise using the urban terrain model. Teams identify defensible positions, axes of advance, and fire support positions.

items.title: Tactical Planning Session
items.description: All commanders around the planning table. Develop the tactical plan: defensive scheme of manoeuvre, task allocation, fire support integration.

items.title: Physical: Orders Brief D1 — Ops Room
items.description: Ops Room, Building 2. Commander delivers orders to all element commanders. Confirm tasks, timings, coordinating measures.

items.title: Day 1 Summary Report
items.description: Element leaders submit Day 1 planning summaries: assessment findings, questions for commander, resource requests.

items.title: Day 1 Close
items.description: Day 1 activities concluded. Participants released for overnight recess. Exercise resumes Day 2 at 0800.

items.title: Physical: Morning Brief D2 — Main Hall
items.description: Day 2 commences. Commander delivers the execution brief. Phase 1 tasks, timings, fire support summary. Physical location: Main Hall.

items.title: Execution Phase Alpha — Zone Alpha
items.description: Teams execute Phase Alpha tasks in Zone Alpha. Establish defensive positions, conduct clearing patrols, report contact.

items.title: SITREP D2 1200
items.description: Midday situation report from all elements. Progress on Phase Alpha tasks, casualties (simulated), ammunition status.

items.title: INJECT: Urban Contact
items.description: Exercise inject: one section in Zone Alpha reports contact with hostile elements occupying a building complex. Commander's decision required.

items.title: Decision: Engage or Contain
items.description: Commander decides whether to engage the contact directly, contain and bypass, or request reinforcement.

items.title: Consolidation Phase
items.description: All elements consolidate positions, resupply, treat casualties (simulated), and prepare for end-of-exercise administration.

items.title: Physical: Final Debrief — Conference Room
items.description: All participants in Conference Room, Building 1. Commander's assessment, element reports, lessons observed. Physical location: Conference Room.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise concluded after 2 days (working hours only). Synthetic time deactivated.
